notes.title: Fear of The Unknown - Scene Two Teaser
notes.content:
Hey You!


We are so happy and excited to finally be able to share this teaser with you today.

We've received great feedback from Scene One (Part one) of the game and as promised before, we are considering every piece of advice and implementing many new features which will be coming out along with Scene Two.


Now let's take a look at the teaser. (Below Image)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ERVKCrR.png[/img]

Scene Two will follow the player as Michaela Anakin (Character on the right) as she struggles to live in the high-tech city that is ruled and owned by one man, Atlas (Character in the middle). And we can all agree that we shouldn't speak of the mysterious and dark character on the left. Perhaps it'll be your role to learn more about that specific character.


We are promising that there will be one more teaser (short video) coming out soon to showcase more of the environments and the challenges that you will have to face.

We are also working hard on new features including a (Save/Load System) and retouching of the first scene to make sure that it runs smoothly and is much scarier.

There is a lot of new and cool things that we've been working on that are going to be released along with the new scene sometime soon.

We truly cannot wait to see all of you playing Scene Two and we guarantee that it will exceed your expectations from the first scene.


Please make sure to reach out to us for any help, bugs, and/or questions via the following:

Discord: Mr. Saaed#6633



Much thanks,

Bad Days Game Studios.

notes.title: Bugs and Questions Help.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,


We appreciate everyone that has supported us so far. We've noticed and are aware of some bugs rising up.

We've come up with a short list to help you get started while we look further into those issues.

Before we get started, we would like to give a special thanks to [b]Valentin Maggio[/b] for helping us test the game on other platforms including Mac OS X.

1) [strike]If you changed your controls, most specifically [ E ] or [ USE ] then some objects still require you to use the [ E ] key even though you changed it. (we will be working on fixing this).[/strike]  [b][FIXED][/b]


 [b]*NOTE*[/b] 2) You can find the Brightness bar by clicking [ ESC ] and find it [ BOTTOM LEFT ] (don't click options).


 [b]*NOTE*[/b] 3) Make sure to click [ TAB ] to check your inventory and tasks.


4) [strike]Multiple issues in the "Red Room" causing player to be stuck there.[/strike] [b][FIXED][/b]


5) [strike]Players encounter issues when changing the Controls.[/strike] [b][FIXED][/b]


6) [strike]The game does not work on Mac OS X or Linux. [Working on it] (Expected patch by Sep 5)[/strike] [b][FIXED][/b]


Please make sure to reach out to us for any help, bugs, and/or questions via the following:

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fear_of_the_unknown_game/

Email: SaaedBadday@hotmail.com

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/FearOfTheUnknownGame/

Discord: Mr. Saaed#6633


Make sure to check back here from day-to-day to check on bug fixes until the next major update.

We apologize in advance for any inconveniences.


Much thanks,

Bad Days Game Studios.

notes.title: Fear of The Unknown Early Access Submissions
notes.content:
[b]If you are a Content Creator then this is for YOU!![/b]


[b]Bad Days Game Studios[/b] is offering a few of you the chance to receive free and immediate Early Access to [b]Fear of The Unknown[/b] and all permissions to publish whatever you would like.


With our first game just around the corner, we wanted to give Content Creators the chance to try out our game and give us feedback along with their fans' thoughts and ideas so that we can implement some of them before the official release.


If you are interested in hopping onto this limited time offer; then all you have to do is let us know that you are interested by emailing us at ( [u]SaaedBadday@Hotmail.com[/u] ) And make sure to link us your channel and/or content's page.
[i]*NOTE: We will only email you back if you have been awarded a spot in the Early Access.[/i]


We thank you for your interest in [b]Fear of The Unknown[/b].


Much Thanks,

[b]Bad Days Game Studios[/b].
